  PROBLEM: `rb_sc_handled` is incremented (line 1018) before the `comments_unreadable` and `already_requested` dedupe checks, so runs skipped without a POST still use one of the 3 rerun slots. The fourth and later runs are therefore never rerun.
  WHY: On later passes, runs 1-3 are skipped as `already_requested` but fill the cap, so run 4 is logged `rerun_capped` every time and the block stays. Only the fresh-run cap is tested. Severity is MAJOR (high) in all five reviews. Gemini describes the same cap problem for failed POSTs, with confidence 4.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4860-4869 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `rb_judge` step env does not pass `RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED` (read at scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:888 and 1035), so the documented kill switch has no effect in CI.
  WHY: An operator who sets the variable to false still gets the automatic `rerun-failed-jobs` POST, because the script sees it as unset and defaults to on. Reviewers' confidence was 4-5. Sonnet 5.5 chose not to re-flag this as a deferred item.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:273 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Run ids pass through jq `unique`, which is a string sort, so `10000` sorts before `9999`.
  WHY: When more than 3 runs qualify, the choice of which runs get a rerun is arbitrary, with no safety impact. Both reviewers rated it NIT, with confidence 5 and 3.

  WHY: If the first 3 attempts fail, the cap is reached and `rerun_capped` is logged. If the failure persists, no rerun is ever requested and the block is never cleared.

  WHY: When more than 3 runs qualify, the runs picked for rerun are the lexicographically first (`10000` before `9999`). There is no safety impact, but the selection is non-deterministic.
